icon.description: Reserved asset ID; empty until production asset mappings are defined.

icon_url.description: Existing profile avatar URL or data URI; empty when unset.

bgimg_url.description: Self-authored SVG data URI for the initial town; production assets are deferred.

SceneSnapshot.description: Registered selected or feature-owned activity scene. Actual sleep, unfinished work, membership and runs override ordinary selection; conflicting exclusive facts are preserved. GET never joins, advances, settles or recovers gameplay.

id.description: Scheduled action ID, or sleep for the observed sleep/wake recovery timer.

is_ready.description: Deadline has elapsed. Pending/Processing work remains unfinished; this does not certify settlement.

params_schema.description: Same strict ActionID-specific Gateway params schema, with explicit selected constants. Required lists the complete command; send full mutation params.

params_template.description: Explicit selected values only; never an implicit mutation-target binding.

PlayerContextResponse.description: Shared GET/post-command selected-scene composition with four slots and non-null arrays. Only connected, scene-appropriate eligible commands are offered; required reads fail the whole observation.

action.description: Catalog ActionID. Eligible entries do not certify adapter coverage.

params.description: Typed command parameters. Required values cannot be absent/null; unknown fields and actor overrides are rejected. May be omitted for no-input commands.

item_id.description: Explicit SecretShop catalog item ID; the service validates current availability.

quantity.description: Explicit quantity; the existing service accepts 1..99 and rejects other integers. No REST quantity default is applied.

target_id.description: Public Home, available shop item or Casino room ID, validated by the selected adapter. Room selection never grants admission.

params.description: Exactly one of offset or cursor. Cursor is accepted only for Home inbox/outbox; empty cursor starts the existing keyset reader.

CharacterActionSuccess.description: Known success is preserved, including result and HTTP 200, when refresh fails. Context is then null with CONTEXT_REFRESH_FAILED; re-fetch GET context only.

CharacterActionRejection.description: Known service or entry rejection retains its original 4xx/code even if refresh fails. No partial context is returned.

action.description: Game-specific masking uses ？？？ for a hidden action.

NavigationSubject.description: Both strings are empty when no subject is selected; otherwise validated by the registered adapter.

NavigationSelection.description: Bounded ordinary selection. Limit 0 means the default 20; no feature activity or actor identity is stored.

ScenePageInput.description: Exactly one of offset or cursor. Cursor is accepted only for Home inbox/outbox; empty cursor starts the existing keyset reader.

BankSceneData.description: Owned Bank state from GetState; observation never executes NPC talk, navigates or mutates savings. Bank talk/inspect REST routes remain for independent reconciliation and retirement.

mode.description: Present for service-verified activity continuations/recovery. entry_eligible is false for these controls; connected still determines execution support.

SceneSupport.description: Details are typed by the facility adapter. Connection and entry eligibility remain separate.

ShopProduct.description: Exact GetCatalog facts. Purchase ID is explicit, independent of mutable navigation; quantity must be supplied separately. Presence means current catalog membership, not a funds/capacity guarantee.

actions.description: Eligible role/phase continuation candidates. Conflicts expose only verified recovery/leave candidates. Execution connection is reported separately in scene.support.actions.

party_id.description: Existing explicit run-to-party relation when present; a matching live roster and its single run are one activity. Missing linkage is never inferred.

CasinoLobbySceneData.description: Offset pages within the existing public window of at most 100 active rooms, sorted by ID. No snapshot or discovery beyond that window is promised. Reading does not admit the actor; service-owned idle expiry and its errors still apply.

CasinoSelectedSceneData.description: Public room summary; selecting is not joining or spectating. No admitted/private detail is exposed. Password and spectator allowance are enforced on explicit commands.

CasinoRoomControls.description: Service-owned role/phase candidates. Actions are room-game action values (Doppel marks included); actual commands revalidate all prerequisites. Spectators have no playable actions; conflict and sleep suppress play/start/kick.

SecretShopPurchaseParams.description: Explicit catalog target template; the purchase command additionally requires editable quantity.

SecretShopProduct.description: Exact SecretShop status item facts after required HelperQuest filtering. Selection and purchase use the catalog ID, never an inventory instance or implicit saved target.

SecretShopCatalogSceneData.description: Qualified read-only SecretShop observation. GET does not invoke NPC actions or purchase. Status and purchase REST operations are retired; NPC interaction REST operations remain registered.

SecretShopProductSceneData.description: Qualified read-only SecretShop observation. GET does not invoke NPC actions or purchase. Status and purchase REST operations are retired; NPC interaction REST operations remain registered.

DepotSceneItem.description: Owned storage instance facts; quantity is not the number of occupied depot slots.

item_count.description: Total occupied slots across the depot, before paging; not summed item quantities.

next_expansion_cost.description: Gold cost for the next expansion at observation time, or null at the purchased expansion cap. Execution charges the current service-owned tier.

DepotSceneData.description: Owned read-only Depot inventory/capacity. Offset pages preserve GetDepot order (currently instance ID ascending in persistence); no cross-page snapshot is promised. Missing depots remain empty in-memory projections. GET never creates, sorts or saves storage. REST operations remain registered pending verified mutation replacements.
